title: $1,000 in McDonald's in 1990 is now worth this
caption:
In 1990, McDonald's was selling burgers.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:MCD:1990-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with McDonald's in 1990? 👇
sources: McDonald's price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Today, it would be worth about {growth:MCD:1990-01-02}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
